buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) SCOPE OF WORK The scope of work would include providing all housekeeping services including sweeping, mopping, cleanin g office premises, dusting, record arrangement and general upkeep of the furniture & other office equipme nt. Cleaning of walls/wooden partitions, Floors, Desks Chairs, tables, other fixtures, removal of cobweb fro m ceiling and fan, dusting of office equipments, window panes /grills and roof upto ceiling height, disposal of garbage anywhere shall be included in the scope of work. The job shall include cleaning of toilets, wash basins, W.Cs Floors, Recreation clubs along with wall tiles da ily with water and detergent, stains removal in the toilets with acid and detergent. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. BACKGROUND & TERMS & CONDITIONS Housekeeping/Cleaning/Sweeping and Upkeeping services of the office of Chief Postmaster General, Uttara khand Circle, Dehradun-248001. 2. ADDITIONAL WORK In case, Head of Circle requires assistance for any other type of work, which does not fall in the job content

s of this contract or on any day services of their personnel is required, beyond the prescribed duty time, ex tra payment shall be made on per man hour basis calculated proportionately based on the approved (appli cable under Minimum Wages Act) of Labour rate of Govt. of India manpower rates. However, for full day du ty, the per day rates, as applicable from time to time, shall be paid and per hour rates shall not be applica ble. 3. PAYMENTS Payments shall be released on a monthly basis against the pre-receipted bills received from the vendor aft er ascertaining that the quality of the services rendered by the Contractor were satisfactory and all person nel deployed, were present on all working days during the period covered by the bill. Payment prescribed from time to time by the Govt. of India (unskilled, semiskilled and skilled workers) plu s statutory payment on account of Employee's Provident Fund, ESI, EDLI etc. for manpower shall be made at the rates applicable under Minimum Wages Act of Govt. of India, New Delhi. The contractor shall get the attendance sheet from this office within 02nd of every month & submit payme nt release sheet & pay slip of its personnel along with their bill for every month by 05th of every month alo ng with EPF payment Electronic Challan Return (ECR) & ESI payment challan, GST Payment Form 3-B retro spective month. No increase in the rates during the contract period shall be entertained for whatsoever reasons except tha t in case of increase in minimum wages by Government of India, New Delhi, the manpower rates will be re vised proportionately. The contractor has to ensure and furnish a Certificate along with the monthly bill that payments to the pers onnel deployed have been made in strict compliance of the provisions of the Minimum Wages Act and that necessary payments on account of statutory provisions, for e.g. EPF 12%, ESI (3.25%), EDLI 0.5%, EPF AD M Charges 0.5% etc. have been deposited with the concerned authorities, failing which the contract shall n ot only be terminated and security deposit forfeited but any other action, as deemed fit by Head of Circle s hall be taken. Service Tax will be paid on statutory payment like ESI/EPF/EDLI/ADM payment. If any of the employees of the contractor is found absent, the contractor shall immediately provide replace ment at no additional expenses. Any absence without replacement shall entail deduction at the rate of the amount equal to 12 times the prevalent per man day charges. If the substitute reports for duty after 10.00 AM, it will be viewed as absence for the half day and payment on that account shall be restricted by the a mount equal to half the prevalent per man day rate. Final bill shall be paid after 30 days from the completion / termination of the contract. 4. MANPOWER 02 person (sweeper) shall be deployed at the O/o the CPMG, Uttarakhand Circle, Dehradun. This number i s, however, subject to change with the provision that the charges for manpower shall be increased or decr eased in proportion to the number of person deployed. It will be binding on the vendor to provide addition al manpower, as and when asked for by Head of Circle. 5. TIMING 02 sweeper employees shall perform duty of 08 hours on all working days. Reporting timing may be shifte d as per requirement on daily basis. Head of Circle have the right to detain the sweeper employee beyond the duty hours on need basis and payment of overtime calculated on per man hour basis on prevailing rat es for manpower costs shall be made for the same. 6. SCOPE OF WORK The scope of work would include providing all housekeeping services including sweeping, mopping, cleanin g office premises, dusting, record arrangement and general upkeep of the furniture & other office equipme nt. Cleaning of walls/wooden partitions, Floors, Desks Chairs, tables, other fixtures, removal of cobweb fro m ceiling and fan, dusting of office equipments, window panes /grills and roof upto ceiling height, disposal of garbage anywhere shall be included in the scope of work. The job shall include cleaning of toilets, wash basins, W.Cs Floors along with wall titles daily with water an d detergent, stains removal in the toilets with acid and detergent.

7. SERVICES General Cleaning Services to be provided on daily basis: · Cleaning/Dusting of furniture, toilet/washbasin cleaning of the entire office during the duty hours. · Removal of waste paper and any other garbage from the entire premises. · Dusting of cupboards, telephone equipment first with dry cloth and then if required, with detergent sp ray & Colin. · Mopping of common areas/ Officers cabins and Recreation club. · Cleaning of Planters. · Air freshener spray in all cabins, toilets and corridors, at least twice a day. · Restock toiletries in toilets after daily checkups in the morning, afternoon. · Cleaning/mopping of sitting area and reception area and passages on a continuous basis. · Acid cleaning and scrubbing of toilets, wash basins, sanitary fittings, glasses and toilet floors. Thorough cleanliness services to be provided on any other days on specific call basis: · Cleaning of window glasses, frames and grills with Colin or any other good quality detergent. · Vacuum cleaning of carpeted floor, brushing of carpets and the office. · Cleaning of Equipments as and when required. · Cleaning of panel, posters and paintings, wooden cupboards including adjustments where needed. · Removal of cobwebs. · Window sponging and cleaning. · Cleaning of dustbins and buckets with detergent. · Disinfectant spray in rooms/cabins on requirement basis. · Cleaning of rooftops. · Vacuuming of curtains/upholdings etc. 8. RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE CONTRACTOR(S) Strict compliance of the terms and conditions of this document should be maintained by the contractor. Th e staff employed by the contractors shall be subject to inspection by the authorized officers of O/o the CPMG, UK Circle, Dehradun. The contractors shall make payments to its employees in strict observance of Minimum Wages Act and other statutory requirements with regard to ESI/PF etc. Any failure on the part of the contractor in this regard will entail termination of the contract and forfeiture of the Security Deposits i n addition to other penal action as per law. Monthly salary and over-time payment to its employees will ha ve to be release before 7th day of following month through Bank Account and details of bank transfer of p ayment shall be submitted alongwith monthly bills of the contractors. The contractors shall maintain a log book in which daily attendance of the staff shall be marked to ensure that required number of persons are present in the office of duty and also wear proper uniforms. The contractors shall make ensure that their personnel deployed in various offices of duty attend all the jo bs and complaints promptly. The Contractors shall take case of any complaints regarding unsatisfactory jobs and shall in addition, atten d to any other job assigned by the authorized representative of the Office head. The contractors shall be responsible for the discipline of its personnel deployed at allocated premises. Any failure in this regard, will be viewed as breach of contract leading to forfeiture of security Deposits and oth

er action, as deemed fit by Head of Circle. If any of the contractor's employees is found absent, the contractor shall immediately provide replacement at no additional expenses. Any absence without replacement shall entail deduction at the rate of the amou nt equal to the prevalent per man day charges. If substitute reports for duty after 1½ hours of the time of duty, it will be viewed as absence for the half day and payment on that account shall be restricted by the amount equal to half the prevalent per man day rate. If any of the contractor's employees is found to be arrived late by more than 15 minutes for three days or more in a month than it will be viewed as absence for half day for each three days late and payment on th at account shall be restricted by the amount equal to half the prevalent per man day rate. The contractors shall ensure that property of Post Office premises is not damaged due to negligence of con tractors' employee while on duty. In case of any damage, the contractors shall be responsible to bear the l osses. Only adult personnel shall be deployed for duty by the contractors. The contractors shall deal and settle the matters connected with service matters / service conditions of its employees, Union activities etc. and shall make sure that no labour problem is passed on to Chief Postmas ter General, Uttarakhand Circle, Dehradun under any circumstances, all precautions shall be taken by the contractors to ensure that no liability on account of its personnel deployed to serve the offices is in any co ndition passed onto the Head of office. The contractor shall ensure that the staff employed by them is well mannered, etiquette, well training in th e housekeeping/cleaning services and posess good conduct. He would also submit character verification of its employees, deployed in offices from the police authorities within one month of the award of contract to Chief Postmaster General, Uttarakhand Circle, Dehradun. The contractor should indemnify the Chief Postmaster General, Dehradun at all times against all claims, d amages or compensation under provisions of payment Wages Act, 1923, Minimum Wages Act, 1948, Empl oyee's Liability Act, 1938, the Workmen Compensation Act, 1923, Industrial Disputes Act 1947, Shops and Essential Commodities Act including any amendments to the said acts or any other law relating to such co ntracts made here under from time to time by Central or State Governments or any other Authorities. Chie f Postmaster General, Dehradun shall not be subjected to own any responsibility under the provisions of a ny such Acts, Laws or Rules. 9. TERMINATION AND PENALTY The contractors shall be responsible for compliance of the terms & conditions of this agreement, failure on this account will attract forfeiture of their security deposits as well as termination of their contract. In the e vent of termination of the contract, Chief Postmaster General, Uttarakhand Circle, Dehradun shall be free t o get the work done through some other agency for the remaining period of the contract at the cost and ris k of the contractors. In case of unsatisfactory performance on the part of the contractors and their personnel Chief Postmaster General / head of office shall be at liberty to deduct upto 25% of monthly billed amount. 10. MISCELLANEOUS TERMS & CONDITIONS The decision of the Head of Circle i.e. Chief Postmaster General, Uttarakhand Circle, Dehradun on any disp ute, arising out of or relating to the contract including the interpretation of a part or full of his document, s hall be final and binding on the contractor. The Head of Circle i.e. Chief Postmaster General, Uttarakhand Circle, Dehradun reserves the right to reject the quotation/bids/contract without assigning any reason. This document shall be interpreted as per Indian Laws and shall have Dehradun jurisdiction. The lowest tender shall be decided on the basis of lowest cost. 11. ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS FOR A PARTY TO PARTICIPATE IN THE TEND ER The eligibility of the vendor to participate in the Tender shall be as under:

· The vendor should have registered under ESI Act (Certified copy to be attached). · The vendor should have registered under Service Tax Registration / GST (Certified copy to be attache d). · The vendor should have Provident Fund Account Number allotted by Provident Fund Commissioner. · The contractors must have PAN card and GST registration number. A copy of the same should be sub mitted with Technical Bid. 12. PROCEDURE FOR SUBMISSION OF THE BIDS The Bid should be submitted in two parts i.e. Technical Bid and Financial Bid through GeM Portal (online m ode only). Financial Bid of only those tenderers, who meet the eligibility criteria and whose Technical Bid is accepted by Head of Circle i.e. Chief Postmaster General, Uttarakhand Circle, Dehradun shall be opened by the duly constituted Committee in this office. No price should be mentioned in Technical Bid otherwise the bid is liable to be rejected. .
